nodes.label: W3C RDF Schema (RDFS) 1.1 Data Description Language
nodes.description: Data-modeling vocabulary for RDF data, providing resources for describing groups of related resources and relationships between them using classes and properties.

nodes.label: PCI Express 6.0 Flow Control Unit (FLIT) Protocol
nodes.description: High-speed serial computer expansion bus standard operating at 64 GT/s per lane using PAM4 signaling and 256-byte FLIT packet structures for low-latency hardware interconnects.

nodes.label: QALM (Qatar Arabic Language Model) Foundational Suite
nodes.description: Sovereign Arabic generative foundation model series designed for complex morpho-syntactic reasoning, entity extraction, and cross-dialect understanding.

nodes.label: SPHINCS+ Stateless Hash-Based Digital Signature Algorithm
nodes.description: Post-quantum cryptographic scheme relying on the security of cryptographic hash functions, underlying the NIST FIPS 205 standard for stateless digital signatures.

nodes.label: Louvain Modularity-Based Community Detection Algorithm
nodes.description: Heuristic method based on modularity optimization for detecting hierarchical community structures and partitioning dense clusters in massive knowledge graphs.
